I wrote `factory/runs/001-title-max-length/spec.md` and changed nothing else. I didn't run any tests.

The spec has three acceptance criteria for SR-1.3:
1. `create_task("x" * 81)` raises `ValidationError` with "Title must be at most 80 characters."
2. `create_task("x" * 80)` returns a `Task` with that title.
3. The length is measured on the cleaned title. Padding an 80-character title with spaces is still accepted, and padding an 81-character title with spaces is still rejected.

The third criterion goes beyond the issue's acceptance check. The issue's Change line says "cleaned title", and `validate_new_task` already strips the title before applying its rules. I wrote the criterion from those two facts rather than leave the whitespace case unspecified.

The test line is `Test: app/tests/test_tasks.py::test_sr_1_3_title_at_most_80_characters`. The "Out of scope" section is copied from the issue: the other rules, `summary()`, the Task fields.
